display.text:
<?php

namespace Illuminate\Container\Attributes;

use Attribute;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Container\ContextualAttribute;

#[Attribute(Attribute::TARGET_PARAMETER)]
class Config implements ContextualAttribute
{
    /**
     * Create a new class instance.
     */
    public function __construct(public string $key, public mixed $default = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the configuration value.
     *
     * @param  self  $attribute
     * @param  \Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container  $container
     * @return mixed
     */
    public static function resolve(self $attribute, Container $container)
    {
        return $container->make('config')->get($attribute->key, $attribute->default);
    }
}

The Foundation test errors are pre-existing (same result with my change stashed), so they're unrelated. All container tests pass.

Fix in `src/Illuminate/Container/Container.php` (`resolveDependencies`, Container.php:1351): previously an attribute-resolved value of `null` fell through `$result ??=` into primitive/class resolution, throwing `BindingResolutionException` for nullable primitives. Now attribute-resolved values (including `null`) are used directly and resolution skips the fallback, while preserving variadic handling and after-resolving callbacks.
